 test.

Verify the results match the relay setting, if 
 not consult technical services

Test trip the breaker associated with the 
 relay

Make sure CT secondary circuit is shorted at 
 the incoming terminal blocks before isolating the relay current circuit for 
 test.

Look at field maintenance file and compare 
 position of the setting switches on relay.

Connect test leads between the current 
 terminals number ( 5 and 6 ) on the relay to the current terminals on the 
 test set

Slowly increase the current until the contacts 
 close the relay must operate with a current between + 10% of the 
 setting value.
Record this value on the test sheet.

Increase the injected current with a value 25% 
 greater than the operating value .

Slowly decrease the current until the relay 
 resets.
Record this value on the test sheet.

Connect the time delayed contacts numbers ( 1 
 and 2 ) on the relay to timer terminals on the test set

Start the test by injecting current into the 
 relay. The timer will stop once the relay has picked up.
Record this value of time on the test sheet.
Repeat the above test steps for other phases.

Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure P1, which must be performed every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block
The type IFC 66A over current manufactured by 
 G.E this procedure details steps required to completely check the proper 
 operation and calibration the IFC 66A relay
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin 
 Hamdy & eng. Azza Salama, revised by 
 EDEP Co. Quality Control 
 eng. Adel El-Nagar, accepted by General Director eng. Mahmoud Saker and approved 
 by eng. Moustfa Alam Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category
Safety 
 fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is

Line isolation
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted 
 before isolating the relay current circuit for current injection.
Tools and Equipment
Ammeter, 
 Test Leads
Secondary injection 
 test.
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Carefully follow all test procedure steps
Verify the results match the relay setting, if 
 not consult technical services
Test trip the breaker associated with the 
 relay
Make sure CT secondary circuit is shorted at 
 the incoming terminal blocks before isolating the relay current circuit for 
 test.
Look at field maintenance file and compare 
 position of the setting switches on relay.
Testing the Relay
Current Test
Connect test leads between the current 
 terminals number ( 5 and 6 ) on the relay to the current terminals on the 
 test set
Slowly increase the current until the contacts 
 close the relay must operate with a current between + 10% of the 
 setting value.
Record this value on the test sheet.
Increase the injected current with a value 25% 
 greater than the operating value .
Slowly decrease the current until the relay 
 resets.
Record this value on the test sheet.
Time 
Test
Connect the time delayed contacts numbers ( 1 
 and 2 ) on the relay to timer terminals on the test set
Start the test by injecting current into the 
 relay. The timer will stop once the relay has picked up.
Record this value of time on the test sheet.
Repeat the above test steps for other phases.
